notes: The Verilator error "Can't find definition of variable: 'Derived'" is in the header line `parameter int LPARA_STRB_W = Derived`, not in the body. The harness must replace the placeholder (e.g. PARA_APBCDC_DATA_W/8). I removed the generate block and put the PARA_APBCDC_APB5==1 enable into the antecedent. Both resets are used in disable iff because the check says both resets must be high.
